# Image sources and attribution
*2026-09-11 10:29 PDT*

All four images were generated with Google Gemini
(`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`) via the `gemini-image-generator` MCP
server on 2026-09-11, then resized to 1600px wide and converted to
JPEG at quality 85 with ImageMagick.

Usage: illustrative ambiance for the post 'Object Storage for
Research Data: The Layer Git Cannot Hold'. No people, logos, or
readable text were requested in any prompt. Generated imagery, no
third-party rights asserted.

The four prompts share a slate blue and warm brass palette and a
single metaphor family: sealed, separately numbered containers whose
contents are fetched rather than edited.

## hero.jpg

Source file: `~/gen_image/archival_repository_pulled_box.png`

> Generate a 16:9 landscape image with the following description: a
> row of sealed grey archival storage boxes on a steel shelf in a
> cool quiet repository, each box closed and bearing a small blank
> brass accession tag, one box pulled forward slightly from the row
> as if just retrieved, soft directional light falling from a high
> window on the left and raking across the box lids, shallow depth of
> field so the pulled box is sharp and the shelf recedes into soft
> blur, a muted palette of slate blue and warm brass, the sealed and
> separately numbered boxes suggesting data that is never edited in
> place but only ever added to under a new name, shot as editorial
> still life photography on an 85mm lens, no people, no logos, no
> readable text.

Replaced on 2026-09-11. The original ambiance3 was a glass-partition
reading-room image whose metaphor served a section on data that may
not leave a secure environment. That section was removed from the
post, so the image was regenerated to match the surviving content.
The superseded prompt and its source file
(`glass_partition_reading_room.png`) are retained here for the
record but the image is no longer used.
